no_adcom_quote.quote: This New Molecular Entity (NME) application was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because the application did not raise significant efficacy or safety issues for the indication to be approved.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NINLARO (ixazomib, NDA208462). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, the Medical review, and the Office/Division Director memo all state that the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because it did not raise significant efficacy or safety issues. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee concerns linked to changes in the approval.
